panels.name: target_manager
panels.summary: Target records define local-dev, local-validation, remote-k1s, openstack-k1s-env, and export-only mutation boundaries.

panels.name: profile_topology
panels.summary: Application profiles describe services, ports, protocols, dependencies, secret references, probes, GPU hints, and export behavior.

panels.name: operation_trace
panels.summary: Operation trace covers session, build, manifest, validation, deploy, route, probe, security, export, and promotion events.

panels.name: probe_results
panels.summary: Probe pack covers WebSocket, callback, queue, long-running, model, GPU, and auth-negative probe categories.

panels.name: security_findings
panels.summary: The proof surface records redacted evidence and reserves security review output for advisory findings without blocking export by default.

panels.name: export_promotion_state
panels.summary: Export-only target and profile export fields show k1s, Kubernetes, and Helm handoff state plus promotion readiness metadata.

non_claims: This proof surface does not deploy workloads.
This proof surface does not mutate Kubernetes, k1s, OpenStack, host trust, router, DNS, or firewall state.
This proof surface does not retain raw secret values.
